details:
This update for guava fixes the following issue:

- CVE-2026-102554: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling (CWE-770) during Java object deserialization
  allows an attacker to cause a Denial of Service via OutOfMemoryError (bsc#1284985).

Changes for guava:

- Adapt the generated OSGi data to reality
- Upgrade to guava 33.7.2
 * Changes of 33.7.2
 + collect: Changed MapMaker, CompactHashMap, and CompactHashSet
 deserialization to avoid eagerly allocating as much memory as
 a serialization payload requests (bsc#1284985,
 CVE-2026-102554)
 * Changes of 33.7.1
 + removes the Multi-Release line from our jar manifest, fixing
 an issue under Java 9 and 10 that was introduced to guava-jre
 in version 33.7.0.
 * Changes of 33.7.0
 + Guava module-info.class is now present at the root of the jar
 instead of under a multi-release root. This prevents the jar
 from containing a file at META-INF/versions/9/OSGI-INF/
 /MANIFEST.MF, which occasionally causes trouble for some users
 + collect: Changed some ImmutableMap implementations to create a
 new, lightweight object on each call to view methods like
 keySet(), rather than creating and storing that object during
 the first call for reuse later. This is likely to slightly
 improve performance for some users, but it could lead to
 regressions in unusual cases, such as repeatedly calling
 asMultimap().inverse() on the same ImmutableMap instance.
 + net: Added HttpHeaders constant for on-prefetch-activation.
 + net: Added MediaType constants for application/yaml and
 application/x-pem-file.
 + util.concurrent: Fixed ExecutionSequencer queue stall when
 delegate executor throws RejectedExecutionException.
 * Changes of 33.6.0
 + Migrated some classes from finalize() to PhantomReference in
 preparation for the removal of finalization.
 + cache: Deprecated CacheBuilder APIs that use TimeUnit in favor
 of those that use Duration.
 + collect: Added toImmutableSortedMap collectors that use the
 natural comparator.
 + collect: Changed ConcurrentHashMultiset, ImmutableMultimap,
 and TreeMultiset deserialization to avoid mutating final
 fields. In extremely unlikely scenarios in which an instance
 of that type contains an object that refers back to that
 instance, this could lead to a broken instance that throws
 NullPointerException when used.
 + graph: Removed @Beta from all APIs in the package.
 + graph: Added support to Graphs.transitiveClosure() for
 different strategies for adding self-loops.
 + graph: Added an asNetwork() view to Graph and ValueGraph.
 + hash: Added BloomFilter.serializedSize().
 + net: Added HttpHeaders.CDN_CACHE_CONTROL.
 * Changes of 33.5.0
 + For users of guava-gwt: Google has moved off GWT internally.
 We plan to continue to release guava-gwt for users of GWT and
 J2CL, but the artifact is no longer tested for GWT-specific
 issues, and we have limited resources to fix any unexpected
 issues that might arise. While we do not anticipate any
 specific problems, we can't guarantee how long support will
 continue.
 + Listed the JSpecify annotations as an optional dependency in
 our OSGi metadata.
 + cache: Improved the handling of exceptions from compute
 functions in Cache.asMap(). (We do still recommend using
 Caffeine rather than com.google.common.cache.)
 + collect: Improved Iterators.mergeSorted() to preserve
 stability for equal elements.
 + math: Added saturatedAbs methods to IntMath and LongMath.
 + net: Added image/avif to MediaType.
 + util.concurrent: Added Striped.custom.
